observations.name: pages
observations.snapshot:
- main:
  - paragraph: Live application recording · September 18, 2026
  - heading "From scientific claim to inspectable evidence." [level=1]
  - paragraph: "This recording follows one request through the actual SciFact RAG interface running on a single NVIDIA DGX Spark: enter a claim, generate a qualified answer, and open the cited parent-document evidence."
  - region "Try the running evidence inspector":
    - paragraph: Optional live path
    - heading "Try the running evidence inspector" [level=2]
    - status: The live demo is ready.
    - link "Open live demo":
      - /url: https://scifact.ediacarian.dedyn.io/
    - button "Retry status check"
  - text: Your browser does not support embedded video. Download the instead.
  - region "Showcase details":
    - article:
      - heading "What happens" [level=2]
      - list:
        - listitem: The recorded claim is entered into the live evidence inspector.
        - listitem: The selected retrieval pipeline ranks evidence from the public SciFact corpus.
        - listitem: Local Qwen generation returns a qualified answer with parent-document citations.
        - listitem: A citation moves directly to the complete evidence supplied to generation.
    - complementary:
      - heading "Recording boundary" [level=2]
      - paragraph: "Claim: Side effects of antidepressants increase the risk of stroke."
      - paragraph: The source recording is continuous except for eight seconds of unchanged waiting frames removed at source time 00:39–00:47, and source content after 01:50 is omitted. Results and citations are unmodified. The README GIF is a 24-second excerpt from this same recording.
      - paragraph:
        - link "View the repository on GitHub":
          - /url: https://github.com/stauntonjr/scifact-rag
  - paragraph: Research demonstration only. This closed-corpus prototype is not a clinical decision system, and its generated answer is not medical advice.
  - text: Recorded from application source
  - link "e3bf3b3a802d813ab7c4bf6f5d3b4fe6fdbdc17c":
    - /url: https://github.com/stauntonjr/scifact-rag/commit/e3bf3b3a802d813ab7c4bf6f5d3b4fe6fdbdc17c
    - code: e3bf3b3a802d813ab7c4bf6f5d3b4fe6fdbdc17c
  - text: and API image
  - code: sha256:03f52076e78d2359fe05f466843d7241a387cf5e0690c13e0271e9cbb305823c
  - text: . The recorded media is static. The optional live link is best-effort and may be unavailable.

observations.name: live
observations.snapshot:
- banner:
  - paragraph: Grounded scientific retrieval
  - heading "SciFact Evidence Inspector" [level=1]
  - paragraph: Public benchmark prototype · Local DGX service
- main:
  - region "Trace an answer back to its supplied evidence.":
    - heading "Trace an answer back to its supplied evidence." [level=2]
    - paragraph: Search the SciFact corpus or ask for a grounded response. Generated answers cite only the parent documents shown below, or report exact insufficient evidence.
    - paragraph: Research demonstration only. This interface is not a clinical decision system.
  - region "Scientific claim":
    - heading "Scientific claim" [level=2]
    - text: Claim or research question
    - textbox "Claim or research question":
      - /placeholder: "Example: Rapamycin delays aging in organisms."
    - paragraph: Submit a complete claim. Evidence comes only from the local SciFact corpus.
    - group: Retrieval controls
    - button "Answer with evidence"
    - button "Search documents"
  - status: Ready for a claim.
  - status: Live capabilities are ready.
  - link "View the recorded showcase":
    - /url: https://stauntonjr.github.io/scifact-rag/showcase/scifact-ui/
  - region "Supplied evidence":
    - paragraph: Inspect the source boundary
    - heading "Supplied evidence" [level=2]
    - paragraph: No evidence loaded
- contentinfo:
  - paragraph: SciFact RAG · Evidence-first, inspectable, and bounded to the public corpus.
